title: Bumblebee wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="32" rx="16" ry="11" fill="#d8ecff" transform="rotate(-25 38 32)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="32" rx="16" ry="11" fill="#d8ecff" transform="rotate(25 62 32)"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="33" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#a8d4ff" transform="rotate(-25 38 33)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="33" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#a8d4ff" transform="rotate(25 62 33)"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <rect x="30" y="52" width="8" height="21" rx="3" fill="#5a3a1b"/>
  <rect x="46" y="52" width="8" height="21" rx="3" fill="#5a3a1b"/>
  <rect x="62" y="52" width="8" height="21" rx="3" fill="#5a3a1b"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="16" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="13" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1="42" y1="27" x2="36" y2="17" stroke="#5a3a1b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="16" r="2.5" fill="#5a3a1b"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="27" x2="64" y2="17" stroke="#5a3a1b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="16" r="2.5" fill="#5a3a1b"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="4" fill="#3a2a10"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="38" r="4" fill="#3a2a10"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="37" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="37" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M45 45 Q50 49 55 45" stroke="#3a2a10" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points="50,8 36,26 64,26" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <polygon points="50,8 44,26 56,26" fill="#ffcc00"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="3" fill="#66e0ff"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="22" x2="62" y2="22" stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1="38" y1="76" x2="32" y2="86" stroke="#5a3a1b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="80" x2="50" y2="90" stroke="#5a3a1b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="76" x2="68" y2="86" stroke="#5a3a1b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <polygon points="48,81 52,81 50,88" fill="#5a3a1b"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="43" r="2.5" fill="#ff9b9b"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="43" r="2.5" fill="#ff9b9b"/>
  <!-- arm -->
  <line x1="27" y1="62" x2="20" y2="55" stroke="#5a3a1b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="73" y1="62" x2="80" y2="55" stroke="#5a3a1b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
